title: Rapid Architectural Visualization Workflow
business: Architectural firms creating rapid client-facing video walkthroughs of building concepts.
problem: Standard diffusion-based video generation requires high sampling counts, leading to excessive latency and hardware costs when iterating on design concepts.
solution: The MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora enables high-fidelity video and synchronized audio generation in as few as 4 to 8 sampling steps, significantly accelerating the iteration cycle for architectural previews.
steps: Install the Larryvrh/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo custom nodes into the ComfyUI environment.
Place the minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_ema.safetensors file into the ComfyUI models/loras directory.
Configure the workflow by inserting the LoRA between the model loader and the sampler.
Set the SamplerCustomAdvanced to use the Turbo Sampler with a simple scheduler.
Adjust step counts between 4 and 8, maintaining a strength of 1.0 for optimal output.
outcome: Architects can generate multiple high-quality, audio-synchronized video iterations within minutes, allowing for real-time client feedback sessions.
limitation: The v4 checkpoint can produce motion-smear or trailing ghosting during large, fast-motion sequences when limited to 4 sampling steps; this is checked by visually inspecting high-motion frames and increasing the step count to 6-8.

questions.question: In Rapid Architectural Visualization Workflow, how does the technology address the problem of high latency?
options: By reducing the sampling requirement to 4-8 steps instead of the usual ~20.
By eliminating the need for a base model entirely.
By increasing the strength dial to 5.0 for faster processing.
By bypassing the audio generation component of the model.
questions.explanation: The solution leverages the LoRA to achieve high-fidelity output in significantly fewer steps, directly reducing the time required for generation.
questions.evidence: The MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora enables high-fidelity video and synchronized audio generation in as few as 4 to 8 sampling steps, significantly accelerating the iteration cycle for architectural previews.

questions.question: In Rapid Architectural Visualization Workflow, what is the primary limitation when using the v4 checkpoint?
options: It cannot generate audio at any step count.
It produces over-sharp artifacts at 4 steps.
It may cause motion-smear or ghosting during fast motion at 4 steps.
It requires a minimum of 50 sampling steps to function.
